item.tib: pA Ni ni'i byings kyi mdo
item.skt: pA Ni ni d+hA tu su trA
item.coloph: zhes pa byings kyi glegs bam paN+Di ta 'jigs sdes mdzad pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /zhes rgya gar nub phyogs gu ru k+She tra'i paN+Di ta kr-iSh+No da ya zhes bram ze gcang ma'i rigs su gyur pa de nyid kyi drung du/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal dkon mchog chos grags kyis rab byung bcu gcig pa shing glang gi lor pho brang chen po po ta lar/ rang gis ji bzhin dpyod nus pa dka' yang paN+Di ta'i gsung rgyun la brten nas cha tsam bsgyur ba'o
